    def EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.addClassGroup {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (U : TwoTerm R) :
    AddSubgroup (ProjectiveClass R)

    The subgroup generated by projective classes of summands of finite sums of U. Every element is the difference of the classes of two objects in add(U).

          theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_maximal_presilting {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {H : TwoTerm R → Prop} (hH : IsTwoTermThick H) :
          ∃ (U : TwoTerm R), H U ∧ U.IsPresilting ∧ ∀ (P : TwoTerm R), H P → (U.directSum P).IsPresilting → IsInAdd P.homotopyObject U.homotopyObject

          Every two-term thick subcategory has a presilting member U such that every compatible member already belongs to add(U). The proof bounds the number of independent projective classes by the number of simples.
